reviews.text: Tyson our 2 year old Black Lab is so eager to get inside, he absolutely loves going to Daycare!! Everyone loves him and is very professional and patient with all his energy. I love watching reels on Facebook seeing Tyson having a wonderful time while he is at daycare. We don’t worry at all when Tyson is there we know he is in safe hands!! Thank you Josh and the rest of your staff for taking such great care of our Tyson! I highly recommend Canine Country Ranch !!!

We are so thankful we found Canine Country Ranch! Josh and the entire staff's passion for dogs shines through from the moment you walk in. As a high-energy breed, Ted needs a place where he can run, play, and just be a dog, with people who truly understand what caring for an active breed entails. We absolutely love this about CCR. It's refreshing to find a daycare that puts the dogs' happiness, safety, and well-being ahead of profits. And Ted clearly agrees, because the second those gates open, he's off without even looking back. We couldn't be happier and cannot recommend CCR enough!

What a hidden gem! I can’t say enough about CCR in Laveen. Josh and Kat they truly love & care for all the dogs as if they were their own. I rescued my baby Rosie who was very scared & unsure of people, after her 1st week with Josh she was confident & socializing with the other dogs. She looks forward to going to doggy daycare every day. It gives me peace of mind, not having to worry about her, knowing she’s in the best hands possible. If you’re looking for doggy daycare or boarding your fur babies, don’t hesitate.
I feel very blessed to have found Josh & Kat @ CCR

This is truly the best daycare experience your dog could have! 🐶❤️ We are completely happy with the care they provide. It feels so different from other places—it’s cozy, welcoming, and has such a warm, home-like atmosphere.

The staff is amazing, and you can genuinely tell how much they love the dogs. I especially love that Marylee gets to enjoy both the green outdoor area where she can run and play, and the air-conditioned indoor area.

We’re there every week because Marylee absolutely LOVES it! 🥰 Every time we drop her off, she runs inside so happy. Seeing how excited she is to be there makes us feel confident that she’s in a place where she feels safe, loved, and at home. ❤️🐾

I have been bringing my dog here for the last 2 years 4 days a week and there is no other place I’d trust than Canine Country Ranch. They treat my baby like their own and I know she’s in great care and always getting the optimal mental and physical stimulation. There is no better facility in the general phx area for daycare for boarding! They are the top of the list!

Canine Country Ranch is the only place I would trust my dog to stay at. They have flexible feeding schedules. They accommodate the late night potty breaks. And they UNDERSTAND dogs have to rest. So I love the fact they give the dogs 1-2 hours of nap time during the day. And they are out and running all day long as long as it’s not too hot. Great for high energy dog owners.
U did a very good job with Brownie and she seems very happy . We will be coming back to you guys next vacation .

My nervous boxer Sadie has done half days to socialize and boarded here.  They are incredible!! Sadie tweaked her back the day before our trip. We thought we were going to have to cancel. I called and Josh said, no need to cancel, we can take care of her.
They took excellent care of her!! Sadie was on very limited activity and they gave her extra lovins since she was restricted to the kennel and very limited area for potty.   I cannot praise these folks enough!!
Every person there shows genuine love and caring for dogs!!  Shout out to Kat for loving up my baby while I was gone!

I am just so grateful that I found Canine Country Ranch. I got detailed updates every day with pictures and videos, and I loved being able to see even more photos of them on Instagram. It was so reassuring to see how happy they looked and how much fun they were having.

I swear my dogs are wondering why I brought them back home 😂. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing my babies are well taken care of whenever I’m away. I can’t recommend Canine Country Ranch enough!
Canine Country Ranch took great care of my two pups while on vacation. They went pictures and videos daily and kept me posted on how they were acclimating. Thank you so much!!!

My initial interaction with CCR was very prompt and helpful given it's user-friendly website. Once I got things going & booked, I wasn't sure how my pup would do, considering that he is a super skittish and anxious dog with new places & new people, so with this being his first experience at this location, I felt he would be really cautious. He actually did so good at his initial meet & greet, especially with the way he was welcomed by the staff and the open space the facility had. We were away for a little over two weeks (more than we had planned for) and the staff was very understanding & considerate! It was also assuring when the staff also informed us that he had been adjusting well. We got updates every other day, with additional updates whenever we reached out. We SOOO appreciated the updates, along with pictures and the detailed updates on him. I would highly recommend this location to family & friends to care for their loved pups! Thank you again, CCR, for loving on my boy! He will surely be back!

I can't say enough wonderful things about Canine Country Ranch! Our 6-month-old XL breed puppy, Max, stayed there for two weeks while I was out of state supporting my dad through a major surgery. Leaving him for that long was stressful, but Josh and Alexis made the entire experience so much easier.

From the very beginning, Josh and Alexis were incredibly friendly, caring, and quick to respond whenever I had questions or wanted an update. It gave me so much peace of mind knowing Max was in such good hands. They even emailed me updates and photos every couple of days while I was away - thank you!

The ranch itself is amazing! There is so much room for the dogs to run, play, socialize, and cool off with plenty of water available. You can tell the dogs have an environment where they can really be dogs while still being well cared for.

The biggest surprise was the positive change in Max's behavior. Before his stay, I had been struggling to stop his nipping and jumping, despite trying everything I could think of. After spending two weeks with the pack at Canine Country Ranch, he came home like a different dog! He's no longer nipping or jumping on me, and I truly believe being around the other dogs and the structured environment made all the difference. That was an unexpected and wonderful bonus to an already great boarding experience.

We'll absolutely be bringing Max back for doggie day camp so he can continue playing and socializing. I also really appreciate that the dogs are expected to be current on their vaccinations, which helps create a safe environment for everyone.

Thank you so much to Josh, Alexis, and the entire team for taking such great care of Max. We couldn't be happier, and I highly recommend Canine Country Ranch to anyone looking for a caring, trustworthy, and fun place for their dog!

I travel frequently for work and have been bringing my pup to the Canine Country Ranch for quite some time. I have consistently received excellent service. The owner, Josh, and his staff show genuine passion for their work and care deeply about their guests 🐕 . They take excellent care of the dogs at their facility. I highly recommend it. I have never experienced any issues here as I have at other places in the area. This is the go-to place in Laveen.

Great staff.  Very caring.  Plenty of room for dogs to run.  Cool area for hit days.  My doggies love it and are always excited when we pull in the parking area.  They jostle to see who can get out first and run to the gate
Canine Country Ranch is the best place for your fur baby to have a fun day with other fur babies!  The care givers really care for the dogs, and even better they love their job!

Our pup spent a month here as we toured Europe. He did very well, even lost a little bit of extra weight he's been battling! I think the socialization was very good for him. He was very well cared for - which is very important for anyone boarding a pet. Highly recommend

Canine Country  Ranch is  a great and safe place for my dog Cooper. He get's so excited when I tell him that we are going.  Josh and his staff are wonderful and show their love for Cooper and his friends.  Thank you so much for loving Cooper like you do.

This has been a long awaited review that my husband and I been forgetting to do. We have a black female German shepherd and when we first got her we were scared about socializing her to early due to parvo etc. so she then became reactive towards other dogs. It wasn’t until we found this place and did the first initial meet and greet with Joshua, he saw how she was upon meeting the other dogs and gave us a bit of hope. We began our journey to help her and within 6 weeks we saw a dramatic change in her and building doggie friendship, it wasn’t just Joshua but Riley was the main person who took time out of her day to work with her and we couldn’t be happier with her hard work. She even sent us videos and pictures of how she was doing . We did take a break from dropping Luna off due to life but plan to visit again for her to have some fun with other high energy dogs!

Earl absolutely loves Canine Country Ranch and its kind staff! He was nervous the first time when I left him there, but now runs in so excitedly! It’s helped my families routine when we get busy but still want him to be active. He’s more relaxed when he comes home from a day of doggy play 💕
You can trust that your pup will be loved on and taken care of here!
Huntington  loves coming here. Today staff is great .when she comes home she sleeps
Hands down the best boarding experience we have ever had. Our dog loves it at CCR and we will definitely use their services again. It feels like leaving your dog with a family member.

Cookie loves going to Canine Country Ranch. She gets so excited in the morning and will stay close to her grandpa because she knows he will be driving her. Once there, she runs to Josh, gladly leaving grandpa behind
We tell everyone we know about the wonderful care the staff gives our Doodle. The enriching activity and fun she has all day is evident because she is ready for her bed when she gets home.
It is a great place and we highly endorse it for your canine family member.

I’ve never dropped Max off somewhere and had him basically forget I exist because he’s having that much fun with the people. The second we walk in, he’s all over Josh and the crew like I’m chopped liver. And honestly? Zero regrets trusting Josh and his family at CCR with my dog. Daycare, training, boarding—they handle it all in one spot, and they do everything the right way. Solid & caring place that actually gets dogs. Highly recommend if you want your pup happy (maybe too happy to come home).

Canine Country is by far the best place we have ever had our GSP stay. We are definitely repeat customers! The facility is always clean, the outdoor play areas are amazing, and you can tell the dogs truly enjoy their time there. The staff is incredible! Kind, attentive, and clearly passionate about what they do. The owners are extremely knowledgeable and well-versed in this field, and their communication is always prompt and reassuring. I would recommend them 100% for both boarding and daycare. We wouldn’t trust our gsp anywhere else!

My dog has been attending daycare here and recently had her first boarding stay, and they were amazing. She had so much fun! The staff made sure she received her medications and gave her the extra breaks she needs since she’s older. They also answered all of my questions and were very responsive to messages. I will absolutely be bringing my dog back — thank you so much!

Canine Country Dog Ranch is truly the best. My dog Pretzel absolutely loves it here. I searched for months and it took me a long time to find a doggy daycare that was not only clean, but had a great outdoor and indoor space for the sweltering summer days and also welcoming and felt like a second home. CCR exceeded every expectation.

The staff is incredibly kind, attentive, and clearly love what they do. Pretzel gets so excited the moment we pull into the parking lot, and the second he hears the word “daycare,” it’s game over. Morning drop off is especially funny because once Pretzel sees Josh, I officially no longer exist, I'm just his Uber driver.   No goodbye, no hesitation just pure joy and all the energy in the world.

I feel completely at ease knowing Pretzel is happy, safe, and so well cared for. If you’re looking for a place where your dog can truly thrive, CCR is it. Highly recommend.

I cannot say enough about the care that our dog Mocha receives from CCR.  She loves going to day care weekly.  The moment we pick her up, it's clear how much love and personalized care she receives. Her tail is always wagging, and she's happily exhausted from a day well spent! This facility is truly top-tier; the entire space is spotless and is meticulously maintained, which immediately puts our mind at ease. What we appreciate most is the abundant social interaction; our dog gets to engage in supervised playtime with a carefully matched group of canine friends, ensuring she returns home not only happy but also well-socialized. CCR is more than just a service; it's a second home for our girl and we wholeheartedly recommend it to any dog parent looking for the absolute best in care, cleanliness, and companionship.

Kathy took great care of our 3yo Whippet Whisper. He had a great time and enjoyed his stay there with Kathy. He was happy healthy and loved his runs in her fenced back yard.  We would kennel him there without hesitation.

We absolutely love Canine Country Ranch (CCR) for so many reasons. The spacious grassy play areas give dogs plenty of room to run and play, and the air-conditioned indoor space offers a comfortable retreat from the heat when needed. The designated boarding area is always clean and well-organized.

What truly sets CCR apart is the care and attention the owners put into creating a safe and secure environment. They meet with every new dog, ensure vaccinations are up to date, and never take on more dogs than they can responsibly accommodate. We also love supporting this small, family-owned business.

The owners and caregivers are incredibly responsive, caring, hospitable, and friendly. Before discovering CCR, we visited many other facilities, but none came close to the level of care and connection CCR provides for our fur baby. They treat every dog like family. Not only do they allow dogs to be themselves, but they also honor each one by learning their unique personalities and caring for them accordingly.

This was the first time we ever left our “dogter” with anyone, and we’re beyond grateful to have found CCR. We’ve used both the day camp and boarding services and have had wonderful experiences with each.

Our dog Nimki would give Canine Country Ranch four paws up – complete with enthusiastic tail wags, happy licks, and excited jumps! CCR quickly became her home away from home. She adores the staff, loves seeing her buddies, and eagerly greets new dogs. She wants to be everyone’s best friend! Just saying “You’re going to see Josh and your friends” gets her tail wagging with joy. Her positive association with CCR and everyone there speaks volumes, giving us complete peace of mind whenever we leave her in their care.

We can’t thank CCR enough for the love and care they show our baby girl while we’re away. Knowing she’s in the best hands gives us true peace of mind. We recommend CCR wholeheartedly to our friends, family, and community. If we could give them more than five stars, we absolutely would. No need to look any further – if you have a dog and need daycare and/or boarding, this is the place!
Great place and great people 😊 …

We had an amazing experience with Canine Country Ranch. The website is easy to navigate. I sent a message and quickly heard back. We took our dog (~18 month old male golden retriever) on a tour and were really impressed. The staff, facilities, and admin are wonderful. Super accommodating, welcoming, professional, and attentive. We felt great and really comfortable leaving our pet here. Everything is clean, organized, really well maintained, and thoughtful to dogs. While our dog was in care, we got emails, videos, photos, and quick replies to queries. Our dog took enrichment one-to-one training every other day - this was really easy to request and set up - trainers were incredibly responsive and understanding of areas we wanted to focus on. When we picked our dog up he seemed really happy, excellent weight, and relaxed. Highly recommend this business and we will definitely use them again. We wish everyone at the ranch all the very best. Thank you!!

We have loved Canine Country Ranch since our first visit. Rocco is so full of energy and still a puppy but CCR lets him get all of it out. He has so much fun with the other dogs. I love the posts on Instagram to share with our close family and keep us posted throughout the day. Definitely love CCR being part of our family.

We have taken him for doggy day camp and boarding while we go on vacation. He’s always so happy at drop off and pickup.

Fantastic service! Truly a hidden gem in South Phoenix. Even better to able to support a local small business. Our Pup always has a great time visiting and treat him as their own. This will be our boarding service for as long as we're in The Valley.
Super clean and all the dogs were super happy!

Josh and Alexis are amazing people! They cared and loved for my dog Rosco as if he were one of their own. As dog owners themselves I met their dogs Stanley and Simon and when I tell you these were some of the most polite well behaved loving dogs i have ever met! I know i can trust them with my animals anytime!
If you’re looking for boarding and day camp for your fur baby, this the place to go. The staff is amazing and my pup loves going there. Highly recommend!

First time using a new boarding service can always seem a little uneasy. However Josh, Alexis, Kelly and crew were very welcoming and we knew immediately our dog was going to be in paradise during his stay. The location was also nice and easy to find. Thanks again all at Canine Country Ranch! :)

We love the Ranch and found a second home for our dog. If you are looking for a large space to get some exercise, shaded areas to cool off, obstacle course, attention from staff and other dogs to play with, this is place for you. Josh worked with our dog for some training needs and am so glad we found such a caring, clean and fun place to use for daycare and boarding as well. Why not book a meet and great appointment to take a tour today! The ranch is getting ready for summer and will start to get full.
Thank you for your support Sofia!

CCR is the absolute best! Our boys boarded there for a little under a week, and had an absolute blast. The dogs have access to tons of outdoor space to run, as well as indoor A/C if they get too hot.

The CCR team gives every dog a lot of attention and personalized care. It was our younger dog’s first time being boarded, so we were a bit nervous, but he had a great time playing with the hose, bubbles, and all his new dog friends. We got lots of photos and videos throughout the week.

The owners and staff are very knowledgeable about dog behavior and training. They do proper intros and know how to manage all of the dogs in their care.

CCR is so much better than a traditional kennel for boarding! We already have their next few stays booked.

My husband and I were traveling with our dog Lola, and needed some dog boarding during the day. I was very nervous about her overheating, and she is always looking for a way to escape when away from me. She means the world to us. Josh was very kind to us, did some water play to keep her cool, and provided updates on Lola. It meant a lot to us that he was able to provide a safe space for her. Thank you so much Josh! I absolutely recommend Canine Country Ranch!

Canine Country Ranch is truly the best! They go above and beyond to care for our dogs—Lassie, Copper, and Dot. The staff is incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely cares about the well-being of every dog they look after. They keep us updated throughout each stay and have excellent communication, which gives us so much peace of mind. The ranch itself is absolutely beautiful and always spotless—it’s clear they take pride in every part of what they do. We’re so grateful to have found a place where our dogs are loved and cared for like family. Highly recommend!

The members at the Canine Country Ranch always go above and beyond when they take care of my little Dot. I have full confidence that she's in good hands every time I drop her off. They are my go to boarding facility when I am in need of someone to take care of them for several days. When I message or call them, they typically respond right away and are very patient with me when I have any questions regarding my dog's stay.
Fantastic customer service and excellent personal care, I strongly recommend considering them for dog boarding.

We bring our puppy, Zelda, to day care here weekly, and whenever we need extra care. Josh is incredibly friendly and communicative, making the whole experience seamless. Zelda absolutely thrives on her playdates with her furry friends. I've never used day care or boarding before, but it's clear Zelda needs the socialization and fun. Seeing how excited she is to be dropped off, and the exceptional care she receives, has completely eased my past anxieties. In fact, I'm now confidently planning to board her here multiple times this year – something I never thought I'd do after 20 years of dog ownership. Thank you, Josh, and the team, for always making Zelda's days so happy and well-cared for.

Canine Country Ranch did an amazing job taking care of my dog while I was out of town! The facility is huge and wide open! Caring people and they do a great job keeping you up to date on how your dog is! No hesitation to use them again! Thank you!

We have used Canine Country Ranch Multiple times now, each single time has been a great experience. Josh is great to work with, he always is flexible on pick up and drop off times. Super good at responding and keeping in contact during the stay of our dogs.

I recently heard about CCR from a neighbor and decided to give it a try. The owner is very friendly and knowledgeable. We took our dog Frankie, who immediately loved the property that has multiple large open play areas. Quickly, we went from one to two days per week. Not only does it allow her to socialize with other dogs and get excess energy out, CCR offers enrichment one on one time.  We've already noticed an improvement with her temperament. I'd absolutely recommend them to other dog owners.
What a great place to take your pup. Whether it's boarding for the day or for the week, your dog is sure to enjoy it there.

Words can’t express the love we have for CCR! Being able to leave our Repo while out of town was always a stressful situation. But this time we found CCR! And that has all changed! Joshua did amazing with him and Repo had a blast! We were able to enjoy our vacation without worries! We are looking forward to day camp and future overnight stays. THANK YOU CCR TEAM!!!

Canine Country Ranch is absolutely amazing! Our dog, Watson, has been going there for boarding since they opened, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. The facility is always clean and well-maintained, and the staff is incredibly accommodating and responsive. They gave us a full walk through of their facility before Watson's first stay which was great that they are so transparent. They truly care about the dogs and their well-being. Watson absolutely loves it—he comes back happy, exhausted, and clearly had the best time running around their huge open space. It gives us such peace of mind knowing he’s in great hands. They are also super accommodating to Watson - playing music for him his first night so he was calm, and administering ointment/medicine.
Great service, really friendly

We recently took our dog, Clay, to Canine Country Ranch for the day, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience! The property is absolutely beautiful, set against the South Mountains in Laveen, with plenty of grassy space for the dogs to run and play. Clay had a fantastic time socializing with the other dogs, and we could tell he felt right at home.

The owners take a genuine interest in each dog, and it was clear from the start that they truly care about their well-being and happiness. Their expertise and passion for dogs gave us great confidence that Clay was in excellent hands. When we picked him up, he was happy, satisfied, and clearly had a great day.

We highly recommend Canine Country Ranch to anyone looking for a safe, fun, and welcoming environment for their dog. We will definitely be bringing Clay back!

Canine Country was really wonderful to our pup, Milo!  This was our first stay and Josh, the owner, is very communicative, friendly, and answered all my questions. I love that they send photos and video of Milo’s stay after pick up. Milo seemed happy and healthy and very excited to see us.  We had no issues at all and will definitely return next time we go out of town. Thank you for this excellent service in Laveen! So convenient and treated our little guy well!

Fantastic experience with boarding and close to home. The team over at CCR are great, caring and knowledgeable. I recommend them to anyone. My pup can’t wait to attend their day camp. Thanks again team

This place is amazing! From the friendliest owners to the most thoughtful layout. They welcome your pups as if they were their own and I couldnt be a prouder supporter. If your pups get bored while you’re working, or you have a trip coming and they cant come with. Reach out to CCR. You will NOT regret it!

Santi really enjoyed his week boarding at Canine Country Ranch! I was really worried about having to leave him over the holidays while he was at the tail end of his recovery from a big surgery. Joshua took the time to really understand what Santi needed to stay healthy and happy during his time & created a plan that worked so I felt free to enjoy the time with my family. He even sent some photo/videos throughout the week so I could see how Santi was doing which was a nice surprise. Love what this local business is up to so I definitely recommend them. They'll take good care of you & your pup. See the attached during & after pics, ha!
CCR is absolutely, hands down the best boarding facility I’ve ever used.. and there have been a few! I will definitely board my dogs there again..I highly recommend this facility.

My dog loves Canine Country Ranch!  The facility is beautiful and clean, and the dogs are supervised 24/7, and affordable!  I love that he can be around other dogs and comes home exhausted!  I highly recommend this family owned business the day or overnight!
What a great place to let your dogs run and be loved. Thank you y'all for doing this!

This is such a wonderful place for dogs! My frenchie loves going there and playing with all the dogs. Each area is clean, sectioned off, and under supervision. It's a great way to let your pups release some energy while you need to get things done, or even simply just work. It's a remote workers dream solution! Highly recommend this to anyone looking to utilize doggy daycare or boarding. The prices are fair, the location is scenic, and Josh and Alexis (owners) are kind and hospitable. Come check them out! You'll have no regrets!
I love this place and so does my dog Cookie. She was wiped out after her first day at the Ranch! The owners took care that she had a great time.

From Cookie Hamilton:
Attention all my barking buddies, there is a new fun spot in Laveen to let our fur down and run wild!
The CANINE COUNTRY RANCH!
My humans dropped me off for my first visit and was I thrilled they had found a place that met all my diva tail wagging standards.
CANINE COUNTRY RANCH has humans, (Alexis and Joshua), who knew just what we four footers need to be happy. (But I do believe they consulted with the dogs who adopted them!) The new buildings offer plenty of enticing sniffs and with the lingering whiff of farmland.
The separated, fenced, spaces lets all furries hang with the big ,(& little), dogs. I was even able to get in my daily quota of zoomies in the long runs that were built for speed!  (Although,  I did have to pause my zooms to play fetch with Joshua;  he loves playing ball!)
CANINE COUNTRY RANCH  gets my welcome to Laveen and I hope to sniff more local four footers there soon!

This was truly the best experience our puppies could have ever asked for! The owners are so caring and kind to our puppies. They provided us updates and ensure to take note of any special accommodations and care. I would HIGHLY recommend to any furry baby owner!
